page.overview:
Who is Nari Beksen?

Nari Beksen was a female Human who worked for the Corsignis Property Alliance during the time of the Galactic Civil War. After Corsignis became engaged in a dispute with the Jon-Tow Economic Development Group over the control of trade on the moon Pinett, a group of agents attempted to mediate a resolution to the disagreement and Beksen represented Corsignis during the agents' negotiations.
